# Section Map — Architecture Plan ↔ Build Guide

Use this to find every place a decision needs to change when one part of the stack changes. "Stage(s)" are from the build guide; "§" are from the architecture plan.

| Architecture §                       | Topic                                                                                                                  | Build-guide stage(s) referencing it                                                                                                    | Related skill               |
| ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| §1 Project Goal                      | Scope/intent framing                                                                                                   | — (contextual, no dedicated stage)                                                                                                     | —                           |
| §2 High-Level Architecture           | Diagram of the whole system                                                                                            | — (implicitly underlies all stages; update if any box/arrow changes)                                                                   | —                           |
| §3 Hosting Strategy                  | Oracle VPS, Ampere A1/arm64, "don't over-engineer"                                                                     | Stage 0 (accounts), Stage 8 (instance shape)                                                                                           | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §4 Monorepo Structure                | Nx `apps/`/`libs/` layout                                                                                              | Stage 1                                                                                                                                | `nx-generate`               |
| §5 Frontend                          | Angular, SSR, public/admin responsibilities                                                                            | Stage 1, Stage 6                                                                                                                       | `angular-frontend`          |
| §6 Backend                           | NestJS, Prisma 7 (driver adapter, ESM/CJS interop)                                                                     | Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3                                                                                                              | `nestjs-backend`            |
| §7 OpenAPI                           | Contract-first endpoints                                                                                               | Stage 3                                                                                                                                | `openapi-client-generation` |
| §8 Authentication                    | GitHub OAuth, opaque session (not JWT)                                                                                 | Stage 4                                                                                                                                | `oauth-session-auth`        |
| §9 Database                          | Postgres schema: `profile`, `projects`, `sessions`                                                                     | Stage 2, Stage 3                                                                                                                       | `nestjs-backend`            |
| §10 Image Storage                    | R2, presigned uploads, TipTap/ProseMirror JSON + sanitization                                                          | Stage 5, Stage 11                                                                                                                      | `image-storage-r2`          |
| §11 Nginx                            | Reverse proxy routing                                                                                                  | Stage 10                                                                                                                               | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §12 Cloudflare                       | DNS/CDN/TLS/WAF, edge rate limiting                                                                                    | Stage 0, Stage 11                                                                                                                      | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §13 Docker                           | Multi-stage builds, arm64/QEMU/buildx                                                                                  | Stage 7 (concepts + build), Stage 12 (CI cross-build)                                                                                  | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §14 Deployment                       | GHCR, SSH push-deploy, forced-command key, CI quality gates (coverage, lint/typecheck/format, security scanning, a11y) | Stage 9 (manual), Stage 12 (automated)                                                                                                 | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §15 Server Security                  | SSH hardening, firewall, secrets                                                                                       | Stage 8, Stage 14                                                                                                                      | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §16 Backups                          | `pg_dump` → R2, retention, restore testing                                                                             | Stage 13                                                                                                                               | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §17 Observability                    | Logs, health checks, uptime monitoring                                                                                 | Stage 14                                                                                                                               | `infrastructure-deployment` |
| §18 Development Phases               | High-level phase list (Phase 1–8)                                                                                      | Maps loosely onto the whole build guide — the guide's stage order deliberately differs from this phase order (see build guide's intro) | —                           |
| §19 Architecture Principles          | Decision-making filters for any new proposal                                                                           | Stage 14 (final review pass); also the filter for step 3 of the "Handling a Proposed Change" workflow                                  | —                           |
| §20 Suggested Final Technology Stack | Summary table of every chosen technology                                                                               | Update whenever _any_ other section changes a concrete technology choice                                                               | —                           |
| §21 Key Recommendation               | Why a VPS / learning framing                                                                                           | Rarely needs edits — only if the project's fundamental goal (learning vs. lowest-cost) changes                                         | —                           |

## Using This Table

- **Small internal change** (e.g. a specific `pg_dump` flag): usually only touches one architecture § and its listed stage(s).
- **Cross-cutting change** (e.g. replacing Oracle VPS with another host, or Postgres with another DB): touches multiple §s in this table — update every listed section/stage, then always re-check §20's stack table and §2's diagram, since those two are the most likely to be silently missed.
- **New capability with no existing §** (e.g. adding a feature not covered by any current section): decide where it belongs in the architecture doc's existing structure (or add a new numbered §), then add a corresponding build-guide stage following the Goal/What you'll learn/Steps/Verify/Reference structure — don't bolt it onto an unrelated stage.
